_comment: THE ROSTER. This is the only hand-edited file in the certification system.
scripts/build_api.py turns it into the verification endpoints under
api/v1/certified/, which anyone can query by GitHub username.
Adding someone: append an entry with status 'active'.
Revoking someone: set status to 'revoked' and add revoked_on + reason.
NEVER delete an entry — the endpoint URL must keep resolving so a badge
in someone's README flips to 'not certified' instead of breaking. A 404
is indistinguishable from an outage; an explicit 'revoked' is not.
Usernames are matched case-insensitively (GitHub is), and are stored
lowercase. Levels: certified (built and shipped a RAPP agent that passed
review) and maintainer (also reviews others' submissions).
Roles, not personal data: keep entries to a username, a level, dates, and
an optional public org/handle. No emails, no internal identifiers.

levels.certified: Has published at least one agent to the library that passed review.
levels.maintainer: Certified, and reviews submissions from other publishers.

members.note: Library maintainer account — the reference entry.
